description: This Java class 'EraseChip' provides a GUI component for initiating a chip erase operation on an STM32 microcontroller. It includes a button that, when clicked, prompts the user for confirmation and then executes an OpenOCD command to erase the flash memory.

classes.name: EraseChip
classes.description: A GUI component extending ProcessStatusWindow that facilitates erasing firmware on a device via a button and command execution.

methods.name: EraseChip
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the erase button and its action listener.

methods.name: getEraseCommand
methods.description: Builds and returns the complete command string to execute the chip erase using OpenOCD.

methods.name: getButton
methods.description: Returns the JButton component for integration into the GUI.
